title: Wood Release
body:
Wood Release forms from Earth + Water. Choose a second nature at level 25 after revealing your first at level 10; Dust Release additionally requires a third nature revealed at level 100. Clan Kekkei Genkai holders cannot gain an elemental release.

Techniques:
Level 25: Wood Splinter Barrage (help wood splinter barrage)
Level 45: Wood Binding Roots (help wood binding roots)
Level 70: Deep Forest Bloom (help deep forest bloom)
